history.summary: A 893sqft freehold 3BR at the recently-completed (2023) Arena Residences, D14, asking $2,016 psf — a touch below the $2,036 URA median. The unit is fairly priced and freehold, but resale appreciation is essentially flat (0.83%/yr on 22 txn) and 893sqft is compact for a 3BR, so it reads as a fair-value hold rather than a growth play.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold, slightly below median PSF (-1%), and near Mountbatten/Old Airport Road amenities are positives, but the resale-only rate is only 0.83%/yr on a thin 22-txn series — minimal demonstrated post-completion momentum. A 893sqft 3BR is tight, and as a 2023 project much of the freshness premium is already in the price. Fairly priced, low-growth-signal — a balanced Neutral.
red_flags: Flat resale appreciation 0.83%/yr on only 22 txn
Newer project — limited resale track record
catalysts: D14 / Old Airport Road / East Coast fringe amenities
